alternatives.concept: Social, developmental, clinical and cognitive psychology are combined with organisational psychology, research methods and social perspectives to examine human behaviour across individual and social settings.
alternatives.assessment: Broad direct psychological core with clinical, developmental, cognitive, social and organisational study. Sociology and biological foundations are explicit complements, not specialist substitutes.

alternatives.concept: Brain and behaviour, perception, memory and language form the centre of this programme. Neuroscience and psychology connect with data analysis and computational models of vision, while philosophy examines consciousness, emotion and the self.
alternatives.assessment: Cognition and mind is now implemented by neurobiology, perception, higher cognition, language and psychology, with specific philosophical/computational extensions; broad disease/anatomy/lab substitutions removed.

alternatives.concept: Psychology of work and organisations connects with leadership, diversity, negotiation, behavioural decision-making and empirical research. Sociology and business courses examine the institutional settings in which people work.
alternatives.assessment: Work/organisational psychology is evidenced by a formal target direction and implemented through organisational behaviour, leadership, negotiation, research and behavioural decision-making. Business courses are contextual, not clinical or diagnostic equivalents.

strongestChallenge: The original cognition alternative devoted too much space to broad biomedical disease and laboratory study, and several row matches implied specialist skills not supported by UCR content. Those defects required bounded reconstruction rather than an unsupported equivalence claim.
stopping: Three evidenced distinct programmes; clinical and educational candidate directions retain their separate evidence groups but are not added beyond the maximum.
preservation: External credited structure, interest inventory and roles, broad psychology and organisation course sets retained. Methods/social psychology moved earlier; cognition option removes six weak courses and adds six specific contributions.
